q: The Riemann-Lebesgue lemma states that for any f ∈ L¹(ℝ):
opts: The Fourier transform f̂ is in L¹(ℝ)
exp: Riemann-Lebesgue: f̂(ξ) = ∫ f(x)e^{-2πiξx}dx → 0 as |ξ| → ∞ for any f ∈ L¹. Intuitively, rapid oscillations of e^{-2πiξx} cancel; formally, approximate f by step functions and use that f̂ of a step function decays.
